gog.store_details: The original 2006 Obsidian/Electron Engine build, not 2025's 'Enhanced Edition'.

audio_fixes.title: Enable EAX reverb
audio_fixes.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 ships with its environment effects off and a software sound provider that has no EAX.

audio_fixes.title: Enable 5.1 surround sound
audio_fixes.reason: Neverwinter Nights 2 plays in stereo unless its speaker type is set to 5.1.
